page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance within the ecs.gn5i family, running on the KVM hypervisor. The instance features 56 dedicated vCPUs and 224.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 4.0 GB per vCPU. Graphics and parallel computing acceleration are provided by two integrated NVIDIA P4 GPUs, delivering a combined total of 16 GB of VRAM.

This instance does not include local storage, requiring external block storage solutions for data persistence. Network connectivity is established with a baseline bandwidth of 10 Gbps. The instance does not include complimentary public IPv4 addresses. The lack of local storage and the reliance on older-generation NVIDIA P4 GPUs represent key architectural tradeoffs, positioning this hardware configuration for legacy GPU-accelerated workloads rather than modern, high-throughput deep learning training.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the ecs.gn5i-c28g1.14xlarge offers a high density of dedicated vCPUs and system memory alongside dual GPUs, making it a viable option for workloads requiring moderate parallel processing without the premium cost of newer GPU architectures. Appropriate workloads include video transcoding, low-latency inference, entry-level CUDA development, and general-purpose applications that benefit from GPU-assisted rendering or compute offloading.
